ideas.pitch: A defense-in-depth AI agent framework designed to autonomously analyze smart contracts and web apps for prompt injection and security vulnerabilities during live CTF matches.
ideas.title: AgentShield CTF Agent
ideas.why_it_could_win: Leverages technical difficulty and advanced agent security hardening, aligning with winning patterns from security and agent hackathons.

ideas.pitch: An automated cryptographic vulnerability and side-channel analysis tool tailored for identifying weak key generations and faulty RSA/AES implementations in CTF challenges.
ideas.title: CryptoLeak Analyzer
ideas.why_it_could_win: Tackles a domain-specific and technically arduous area of cybersecurity competitions that judges heavily respect.

ideas.pitch: An investigative dashboard that ingests OSINT data dumps, metadata, and digital forensics artifacts to construct dynamic link analysis graphs for faster flag discovery.
ideas.title: OSINT Graph Visualizer
ideas.why_it_could_win: Combines graph intelligence with rapid artifact investigation, echoing the winning AML risk detection platform architecture.

ideas.pitch: A zero-knowledge proof gating system for CTF platforms where teams can cryptographically prove they found a flag hash without leaking the plaintext flag to shared servers.
ideas.title: ZK-Flag Vault
ideas.why_it_could_win: Showcases advanced ZK circuit engineering, mirroring the technical complexity of winning privacy and secrets hackathon projects.

ideas.pitch: A local developer tool that automatically scans source code repositories for secrets, hardcoded API keys, and security anti-patterns before deployment.
ideas.title: RepoSec Audit Bot
ideas.why_it_could_win: Builds upon proven automated reporting and security insight generators that have taken top prizes at enterprise hackathons.
